name: COFFEE Cattleya （コーヒーカトレヤ）【旧店名】祇園喫茶 カトレヤ (COFFEE Cattleya (Coffee Katoreya / Gion )
why: NOT CURRENTLY TRADING. The 1943-founded kissaten closed May 2024, relaunched 2024-07-03 under a new owner, and that relaunch ended 2026-06-28 with the future undecided. The app shows it as open with regular hours today (2026-08-21). Mark closed/hiatus pending on-the-ground confirmation.

name: GLUTEN FREE CAFE avan 渋谷本店 (GLUTEN FREE CAFE avan Shibuya Honten)
why: 渋谷本店 closed 2024-11 (relocated to Ueno as a churros takeout stand); the Ueno store closed 2026-05-10 and both FMGF and Tabelog now mark the business closed; the Maebashi branch closed 2024-07. The brand has no operating location, and the record's website domain avan-sweets.com no longer resolves.

name: あまつぼ じもの亭 (Amatsubo Jimonotei)
why: Open. The article (dated 2025-03-27) reports the venue opened 2025-02-03 in Omicho Market: 「昨年12月に惜しまれながら閉店した「じもの亭」でしたが、…「あまつぼ」が引き継ぎ、店名新たに生まれ変わりました。」 The Dec-2024 closure belongs to the PREDECESSOR じもの亭, not to this record — do not let that 閉店 wording trip an automated closure sweep.

name: Cafe 甘 本店 (Cafe Kan (Honten))
why: Open and relocated: 「武蔵ヶ辻から尾張町に移転し、リニューアルオープンしています」, current address 石川県金沢市尾張町2-11-29, 10:30-18:00 (L.O. 17:30), 水曜定休. The record already carries the Owaricho address and coordinates, so no fix needed — logged so a later sweep does not re-open this.
